components.textContent:
If your Army Faction is **GENESTEALER CULTS**, you start the battle with a number of Resurgence points, depending on the battle size, as shown below.

■ **Incursion**: 6 Resurgence points
■ **Strike Force**: 10 Resurgence points
■ **Onslaught**: 14 Resurgence points

Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model (excluding **CHARACTER** models) in that unit has this ability, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points shown below based on that unit’s Starting Strength (not including attached **CHARACTER** models).

components.altText: Aberrants. For 5 models, you must spend 4 Resurgence points. For 10 models, you must spend 8 Resurgence points.  Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, or Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers, or Hybrid Metamorphs. For 5 models, you must spend 2 Resurgence points. For 10 models, you must spend 4 Resurgence points.  Atalan Jackals. For 5 models, you must spend 2 Resurgence points. For 10 models, you must spend 6 Resurgence points.  Neophyte Hybrids. For 10 models, you must spend 3 Resurgence points. For 20 models, you must spend 6 Resurgence points.  Purestrain Genestealers. For 5 models, you must spend 2 Resurgence points. For 10 models, you must spend 6 Resurgence points.

components.textContent:
If you do:

■ Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit (excluding **CHARACTER** models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any **[ONE SHOT]** weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
■ Place one Cult Ambush marker (see below) anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed).
Units in Cult Ambush

Cult Ambush is a type of Strategic Reserves. Units in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, but can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker as described below, or by following the rules for Strategic Reserves in a subsequent turn. Units in Cult Ambush are not automically destroyed at the end of the third battle round.
Cult Ambush Markers

Use a circular 32mm diameter marker for Cult Ambush markers. If an enemy model (excluding **AIRCRAFT**) ends any kind of move within 8" of a Cult Ambush marker you placed, that Cult Ambush marker is removed from the battlefield. At the end of your opponent’s next Movement phase, for each of your Cult Ambush markers still on the battlefield, you can select one unit from your army that is in Cult Ambush to make an **ingress move**. For that **ingress move**, set that unit up with at least one model in that unit in base contact with that Cult Ambush marker and all other models placed wholly within 3" of that Cult Ambush marker (that Cult Ambush marker is then removed from the battlefield). Units in Cult Ambush can make an **ingress move** in the first battle round using this rule.

Genestealer Cults keep their fighting strength carefully hidden from their oppressors until the glorious Day of Ascension arrives. Even as most rise up amidst raging battle, reinforcements slip from the shadows or spill up from the dark places below, called to war by the Broodmind.

enhancements.name: Alien Majesty
enhancements.rules: **ABOMINANT**, **BIOPHAGUS** or **PATRIARCH** model only. While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit (to a minimum of 1).

enhancements.name: Biomorph Adaptation
enhancements.rules: **ABOMINANT** or **PATRIARCH** model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Mutagenic Regeneration
enhancements.rules: **ABOMINANT**, **BIOPHAGUS** or **PATRIARCH** model only. In each Command phase, one model in the bearer’s unit regains 1 lost wound.

enhancements.name: Predatory Instincts
enhancements.rules:
**ABOMINANT**, **BIOPHAGUS** or **PATRIARCH** model only.
  • Models in the bearer's unit have the Infiltrators ability.
  • You can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that **stratagem** this phase. If you do:
    • That use is -1 CP.
    • That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

stratagems.name: Evasive Vanguard
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers, before removing those markers from the battlefield.
stratagems.targetRules: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.effectRules: You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Saintly Paroxysm
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a **GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER** model from your army.
stratagems.targetRules: That destroyed **CHARACTER** model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effectRules: Roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If that **CHARACTER** model is an **ABOMINANT** or **PATRIARCH**, that enemy unit suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead.

stratagems.name: Gene-twisted Muscle
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ABERRANTS**, **BIOPHAGUS** or **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Hyper-metabolic Vigour
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ABERRANTS**, **BIOPHAGUS** or **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3". In addition, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends it as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Stimulated Bio-surge
stratagems.whenRules: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ABERRANTS**, **BIOPHAGUS** or **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS** unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit has +2 to **charge rolls**.

stratagems.name: Bio-horror Revelation
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ABERRANTS**, **BIOPHAGUS** or **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit within 9" of your unit is selected to shoot, it must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result. If that test is failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

components.textContent: Add 1 to Charge rolls made for **ABERRANTS**, **BIOPHAGUS** and **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS** units from your army. In addition, each time such a unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

Little can assuage a Genestealer Cult’s least Human instincts, behaviours made even more ferocious under provocation. Stimulated by psionic pulses of the Broodmind or fuelled by alchemical concoctions delivered from alien grafts, impulses drive the blessed to acts of increased savagery.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Reprisal
enhancements.rules: **GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY** model only. When you target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Fire-point Commander
enhancements.rules: **GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY** model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

enhancements.name: Martial Espionage
enhancements.rules: **GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY** model only. Once per turn, when a friendly **ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY** or **ASTRA MILITARUM MOUNTED** unit within 9" of the bearer is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: The Hero Returned
enhancements.rules: **GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY** model only. Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in the bearer’s unit by 1.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Iron
stratagems.whenRules: Any phase, just after an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of one or more of your Cult Ambush markers.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one of those Cult Ambush markers. You can set up that Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units and wholly within 6" of your unit.

stratagems.name: Regimental Reinforcements
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an **ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY REGIMENT** unit from your army (excluding **ARTILLERY** and **CHARACTER** units) is destroyed.
stratagems.targetRules: That **INFANTRY** unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effectRules: Roll one D6: on a 3+, place one Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units (if this is not possible, no marker is placed) and add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any **[ONE SHOT]** weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot.
stratagems.restrictionRules: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: Suppress and Overwhelm
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, just after an **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army has shot.
stratagems.targetRules: That **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem and each time a **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit from your army selects that enemy unit as a target of a charge, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

stratagems.name: Acceptable Losses
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more **GENESTEALER CULTS** units from your army. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after it has resolved those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those **GENESTEALER CULTS** units: on a 5+, the unit being rolled for suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Symbiotic Destruction
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** and one **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit from your army that have not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit that is visible to both of those selected units and within range of at least one ranged weapon from each of those units. Until the end of the phase, models in those units can only make attacks that target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, each time such a model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: A Dark Network
stratagems.whenRules: Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ASTRA MILITARUM** or **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit from your army (excluding **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES**) within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

components.textContent: Each time an **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit from your army (see below) is selected to shoot, you can select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to that unit. If you do, until the end of the phase, models in that **ASTRA MILITARUM** unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and that enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire. While an enemy unit is caught in overlapping fire, each time a **GENESTEALER CULTS** model from your army targets that enemy unit with a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.
Coordinating with their militant allies via stolen vox equipment or signalling with cult icons, the insidious broodkin engulfs the hated foe in overlapping fields of fire.

components.textContent: You can include **ASTRA MILITARUM** units in your army, even though they do not have the **GENESTEALER CULTS** Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:

A **GENESTEALER CULTS** model must be your **WARLORD**, and **ASTRA MILITARUM** models from your army lose the Voice of Command ability if they have it. You cannot include units with any of the following keywords in your army using this rule: **AIRCRAFT**; **COMMISSAR**; **EPIC HERO**; **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS**; **OGRYN**; **RATLING**; **TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER**; **MINISTORUM PRIEST**.

enhancements.rules: **GENESTEALER CULTS** model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Inhuman Integration
enhancements.rules: **GENESTEALER CULTS** model only. Weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability while targeting an enemy unit within 6" of one or more friendly **TYRANIDS** units.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Auger
enhancements.rules: **TYRANIDS** model only. Each time the bearer would regain one or more lost wounds from the Psionic Parasitism Detachment rule, it regains up to twice that number of lost wounds instead.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Tyrant
enhancements.rules: **WINGED HIVE TYRANT** model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

stratagems.name: Hyperferocity
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re‑roll a Wound roll of 1. If one or more friendly **TYRANIDS** units are within 6" of that enemy unit, you can re‑roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Psi Surge
stratagems.whenRules: Start of any phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **TYRANIDS** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the start of your next Command phase, increase the range of your unit’s Catalyst ability by 3.
stratagems.restrictionRules: Each time you use this Stratagem, until the end of your next Command phase, you cannot use this Stratagem again.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Star Children
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.targetRules: One **TYRANIDS CHARACTER** unit from your army that was destroyed by that enemy unit this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the battle, each time a **GENESTEALER CULTS** model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Divine Imperative
stratagems.whenRules: Your Charge phase, when a friendly **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit within 12" of a friendly **engaged** **TYRANIDS** unit **declares a charge**.
stratagems.targetRules: That **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit.
stratagems.effectRules:
• Your unit has +1 to **charge rolls**.
  • You can use this part of this **stratagem**. If you do:
    • Your unit can re-roll **charge rolls**.
    • Your unit must end that **charge move** **engaged** with an enemy unit **engaged** with that friendly **TYRANIDS** unit.

stratagems.name: Darting Attacks
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **TYRANIDS** unit from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Resistance Tunnels
stratagems.whenRules: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **GENESTEALER CULTS** or **TYRANIDS** unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectRules: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

components.textContent:
At the end of your Movement phase, for each **TYRANIDS SYNAPSE** unit from your army, you can select one friendly **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit (excluding **PURESTRAIN GENESTEALER** and **PATRIARCH** units) and one friendly **TYRANIDS** unit each within 9" of and visible to that Synapse unit. If you do, that **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit from your army suffers D3+1 mortal wounds and one model in the selected **TYRANIDS** unit regains up to that many lost wounds and until the start of your next Movement phase, each time a model in the selected **TYRANIDS** unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

**TYRANIDS** units from your army have the following ability:

**Catalyst** (**Aura**): While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a friendly **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
With each tug on the synaptic leash, the Hive Mind drains more of its hapless worshippers.

bulletPoints.text:
You can include **TYRANIDS VANGUARD INVADER** units (excluding **AIRCRAFT**, **BROODLORD** and **GENESTEALERS** units) in your army. The combined points cost of such units depends on your battle size:

■ **Incursion**: Up to 500 pts
■ **Strike Force**: Up to 1000 pts
■ **Onslaught**: Up to 1500 pts

No **TYRANIDS** models from your army can be your **WARLORD.**

stratagems.name: Surging Broodworship
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Killer unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Killer</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Attacks made by <k>KILLER</k> models in your unit have <k>[Devastating Wounds]</k>.

stratagems.name: Loyal to the End
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly <k>Killer</k> unit.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Killer</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules:
When a Killer model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 1, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
  • On a 2+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Living up to Legend
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Killer unit has attacked, if those attacks destroyed an enemy unit or an enemy Character model.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Killer</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Each visible friendly battle-shocked GENESTEALER CULTS unit within 12" of your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

What passes for folk heroism amongst the deviants of the Genestealer Cults is part broodmind compulsion and unwilling worship, and part these champions’ ability to commit deeds of great and terrible violence against any who stand in the way of the cult.

stratagems.name: Coordinated Trap
stratagems.whenRules: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: Two **GENESTEALER CULTS** units from your army that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit (if this Stratagem is used in the Fight phase, that enemy unit must be within Engagement Range of both of your units). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in either of your units makes an attack, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target for that attack), and when resolving that attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Primed and Readied

stratagems.targetRules: One **GENESTEALER CULTS** units from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

stratagems.name: Tunnel Crawlers
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.restrictionRules: A unit targeted by this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

stratagems.name: Lying in Wait
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **GENESTEALER CULTS BATTLELINE** unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, when setting your unit up using a Cult Ambush marker, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Cult Ambush marker and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Return to the Shadows
stratagems.whenRules: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY** unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effectRules: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: A Deadly Snare
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.targetRules: One **GENESTEALER CULTS INFANTRY** unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.
stratagems.effectRules: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

components.textContent: Each time a **GENESTEALER CULTS** unit from your army is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** and **[IGNORES COVER]** abilities.

The insidious broodkin of the cult lurk hidden within the shadows, tirelessly tracking their enemies as predatory beasts stalk their prey. Only when their position is perfect do they strike. Worming into the fight from hidden tunnels, ducts and sewers, they rise to engulf their victims in a hail of unexpected firepower and a flurry of stabbing blades and raking talons.

enhancements.rules: **GENESTEALER CULTS** model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a ranged attack, if it disembarked from a **TRANSPORT** this turn, you can re‐roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.effectRules: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

components.textContent: While a **GENESTEALER CULTS MOUNTED**/**VEHICLE** model from your army is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to its Objective Control characteristic. In addition, at the end of your Command phase, if one or more **ATALAN JACKALS** units from your army are within range of an **objective** you control, that **objective** remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Whether forming loose clans of wandering nomads or militarised rapid-reaction corps, the cultists of Outlander Claws use their experience to launch assaults on prominent targets. Swiftly exploiting or rigging them with proximity charges, they can deny resources to the enemy without yoking themselves to a static defence.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Star Children (Upgrade)
enhancements.rules:
Purestrain Genestealers unit only. This unit has:
  • +1 T.
  • 4+ Sv.
  • This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.

enhancements.name: Talons of the Sire
enhancements.rules: Patriarch model only. This unit’s attacks can re‑roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Inhuman Reactions
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Purestrain Genestealers unit.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Purestrain Genestealers</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Crawling Horror
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly <k>Purestrain Genestealers</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit has ‑6" detection range until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Lurk and Strike
stratagems.whenRules: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Purestrain Genestealers unit is selected to make a fall‑back move.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Purestrain Genestealers</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

components.textContent: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, friendly unengaged Purestrain Genestealer units can be placed in strategic reserves. This detachment has the PURESTRAIN tag and cannot be taken with another PURESTRAIN detachment.
Genestealers on the hunt combine malevolent cunning and inhuman agility to strike and fade again and again, until their prey are reduced to panicked disarray.
components.title: Lore

enhancements.name: Deeds that Speak to the Masses
enhancements.rules: **MAGUS**, **PRIMUS** or **ACOLYTE ICONWARD** model only. You start the battle with 2 additional Resurgence points.

enhancements.name: Denunciator of Tyrants
enhancements.rules: **MAGUS**, **PRIMUS** or **ACOLYTE ICONWARD** model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets a **CHARACTER** unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Gene-sire’s Reliquant
enhancements.rules: **MAGUS**, **PRIMUS** or **ACOLYTE ICONWARD** model only. You can re‐roll Battle‐shock tests taken for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Inspiration
enhancements.rules: **MAGUS**, **PRIMUS** or **ACOLYTE ICONWARD** model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: Vengeance for the Martyr!
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a **GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER** model from your army.
stratagems.targetRules: One other **GENESTEALER CULTS CHARACTER** model from your army.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS**, **HYBRID METAMORPHS** or **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the destroyed model was a **MAGUS**, **PRIMUS** or **ACOLYTE ICONWARD**, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: Frenzied Devotion
stratagems.whenRules: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS**, **HYBRID METAMORPHS** or **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models (excluding **CHARACTERS**) in your unit by 1 and those weapons have the **[HAZARDOUS]** ability.

stratagems.name: Tireless Fervour
stratagems.whenRules: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS**, **HYBRID METAMORPHS** or **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effectRules:
• If your unit made an **advance**/**fall-back move** this turn, that **advance**/**fall-back move** does not prevent your unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.
  • When your unit **declares a charge**, you can use this part of this **stratagem**. If you do:
    • Your unit can re-roll **charge rolls**.
    • Your unit must end that **charge move engaged** with an enemy unit **engaged** with a friendly **CHARACTER** unit.

stratagems.name: Transcendent Celerity
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS**, **HYBRID METAMORPHS** or **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[ASSAULT]** ability.

stratagems.name: The Downtrodden Rise
stratagems.whenRules: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS**, **HYBRID METAMORPHS** or **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit from your army in Cult Ambush.
stratagems.effectRules: Until the end of the phase, you can set up your unit on the battlefield without using a Cult Ambush marker. When doing so, set up your unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: The Path of Anguish
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.targetRules: One **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS** or **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectRules: Your unit can make a move of up to D6", but it unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding **AIRCRAFT**). When doing so, models in your unit can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

components.textContent: For each **ACOLYTE HYBRIDS**, **HYBRID METAMORPHS** and **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit from your army, while one or more **CHARACTER** models are leading that unit, you can re‐roll Advance and Charge rolls made for it. If that **CHARACTER** model is a **MAGUS**, **PRIMUS** or **ACOLYTE ICONWARD**, that model has the Feel No Pain 3+ ability while leading that unit.

Downtrodden by the oppressors for so long, a cult’s lowly broodkin are fanatically devoted to their leaders, for those hallowed individuals serve the Patriarch’s will more directly. The masses draw upon energy reserves in their desire to heed their masters’ wishes, surging selflessly into the fray, ready to hurl themselves in harm’s way for the Patriarch’s chosen.

enhancements.name: Devious Disguises (Upgrade)
enhancements.rules: Neophyte Hybrids unit only. This unit has -3" detection range.

enhancements.name: Inspired to Greatness
enhancements.rules: Magus/Primus model only. This unit’s attacks can re‑roll damage rolls.

stratagems.name: Slunk from the Underbelly
stratagems.whenRules: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Neophyte Hybrids unit with every model within a terrain area.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Neophyte Hybrids</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Eyes of the Cult
stratagems.whenRules: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetRules: One friendly Neophyte Hybrids unit within a terrain area.
stratagems.effectRules: Enemy units within that terrain area have +6" detection range.

stratagems.name: Fanatical Hail
stratagems.whenRules: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Neophyte Hybrids unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.targetRules: That <k>Neophyte Hybrids</k> unit.
stratagems.effectRules: Select one enemy unit. Your unit’s ranged attacks that target that enemy unit can re‑roll hit rolls.

components.textContent: In your Command phase, if a friendly Neophyte Hybrids unit is within a terrain area, that unit heals 3 wounds. This detachment has the HOSTS tag and cannot be taken with another HOSTS detachment.
More and yet more Neophytes surge from tunnel mouths, mine entrances and derelict fortifications, drowning the foe in a tide of fanatical killers.
